scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n api,web "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:speech: concurrently --kill-others -n api,web "npm run dev:api:speech" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api:speech: uv run --locked --extra speech uvicorn server.main:app --reload --reload-dir server --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.speech:setup: uv run --locked --extra speech --extra model-setup python -m scripts.setup_speech
scripts.contract: uv run python -m scripts.export_contract && openapi-typescript contracts/openapi.json -o web/src/api.generated.ts
scripts.check: uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest && npm run test:audio && npm run build --workspace web
uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest && node --experimental-strip-types web/tests/recording.test.ts && npm run build --workspace web
